Name: Style
Description: Specifies the shape and profile of the edge effect applied to the terrain or mask.

Flubs.Name: Round
Flubs.Description: Creates a smooth, rounded edge transition for a softer boundary.

Flubs.Name: Square
Flubs.Description: Produces a straight, angular edge for a more defined and abrupt boundary.

Flubs.Name: Precise
Flubs.Description: Applies an exact edge in pixels, preserving sharpness and detail at the boundary.

Name: Size
Description: Controls the width or thickness of the edge effect. Higher values create a broader edge region.

Name: Pixels
Description: Sets the edge width in pixel units, allowing for precise control over the edge's extent.

Name: Softness
Description: Adjusts the smoothness of the edge transition. Higher values result in a more gradual, blended edge.
